V-M-KERNEL-IDENTITY.Scenario: Identifier grammar accepts well-formed ids and rejects malformed, overlong and empty ones, and capability keys split at the last hash.
deepFreeze freezes plain objects and arrays at every level and leaves Effect Schemas and functions unfrozen.
V-M-KERNEL-IDENTITY.TraceAssertion: identity.test.ts: isLocusId, isExtensionId, isCapabilityName, capabilityKey and parseCapabilityKey describe blocks. freeze.test.ts: deepFreeze describe block.

V-M-KERNEL-CANONICAL.Scenario: Canonical JSON sorts keys recursively, drops undefined members and keeps array order.
digestOf gives the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON, the same for reordered keys, and the sha256 lowercase-hex form.
V-M-KERNEL-CANONICAL.TraceAssertion: canonical.test.ts: canonicalJson, sortKeys and jsonEqual describe blocks. digest.test.ts: digestOf describe block with the SHA-256 test vector.

V-M-KERNEL-DIAGNOSTIC.Scenario: Every diagnostic code has its severity, makeDiagnostic freezes its result, and diagnostics sort by code-unit order with exact duplicates dropped.
elementaryCycles reports each elementary cycle once in a fixed order and stops at MAX_CYCLES with exceeded set.
V-M-KERNEL-DIAGNOSTIC.TraceAssertion: diagnostic.test.ts: SEVERITY, makeDiagnostic, compareDiagnostics and sortDiagnostics describe blocks. cycles.test.ts: elementaryCycles describe block, including the six-node limit test.
